title: lo + adjective ('the … thing'), juntos, fácil, así, lo de

cards.title: Recap: -emos vs -imos
cards.body: The only -er / -ir difference is the we form; everything else is shared.

cards.title: lo + adjective = the … thing
cards.body: Lo interesante = the interesting thing. Junto (together, linked to 'junction') agrees: juntos / juntas.

examples.en: The interesting thing is that they live here.
examples.es: Lo interesante es que viven aquí.
Lo interesante es que viven juntos.

cards.title: lo fácil, lo complicado, lo bueno, lo malo

examples.en: The easy thing is that they come together.
examples.es: Lo fácil es que vienen juntos.

cards.title: Live with some uncertainty
cards.body: Build only the form you need (venir → vienen) instead of chasing other forms. If you wait to master everything before speaking, you'll never start.

cards.title: así = like this / like that
cards.body: A shortcut for de esta manera / de esta forma.

cards.title: lo de = the thing / business about
cards.body: Mañana means both 'tomorrow' and (la mañana) 'the morning'.

examples.en: I don't want to talk about Juan's business like this.
examples.es: No quiero hablar de lo de Juan así.

examples.en: I want to organise that thing for tomorrow, but not like this.
examples.es: Quiero organizar lo de mañana, pero no quiero organizarlo así.
